searchText: How about just using words? Engineers spend for more time reading code then typing it, and everyone has autocomplete editors now. And a long but complete word is easier to read than an abbreviated word (because he an brains are amazing pattern matchers). So in the end, all this abbreviation is sacrificing overall productivity. It is born from people optimizing the task in front of them (typing a word for the first time) over optimizing the overall effort over time.
